goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Steuern, Zertifikate, Gebote/Verbote in verschiedenen Ebenen (EU/Bund/Land) bewerten.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three distinct instrument families: payment toward a public institution, trading certificates with opposing certificate/payment arrows beneath a schematic shared cap, and enforceable rules/checks. The comparison invitation does not assert that one instrument always works best or invent current rates and legal scope.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px panel headings, tax/public-payment icon, two certificate traders with arrows, and regulatory checklist are visible. The footer comparison question remains legible without smaller legal detail.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the reverse directions of certificate and payment trade are clear and the cap remains a conceptual line rather than an invented scale.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The rules worker demonstrates a clipboard toward the audience; he is not shown reading its back. The certificate is displayed between the two traders and no fine directional writing is falsely oriented.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The image groups instrument mechanisms; it is not a full allocation of constitutional competences across EU, Bund and Land. That allocation belongs to the accompanying reviewed learning text.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
